claim: The six key emblems (2540 skull, 2541 eye, 2542 flame, 2543 dagger, 2544 spider, 2545 moon) are placards hung beside a door that wants that key: 80% of the campaign's 265 keyed things carry one. Hung anywhere else they promise a lock that is not there.
use: Hang an emblem only by the lock it names.
